## Skills covered

-   **Design and implement an MLOps infrastructure** on Azure — workspaces, compute, source control, secrets
-   **Implement machine learning model lifecycle and operations** — training pipelines, registries, versioning, CI/CD
-   **Design and implement a GenAIOps infrastructure** — **Azure AI Foundry**, prompt flow, retrieval-augmented orchestration
-   **Implement generative AI quality assurance and observability** — evaluations, guardrails, content safety, tracing
-   **Optimize generative AI systems and model performance** — cost, latency, prompt tuning, model selection
-   Practical use of **Azure DevOps** / **GitHub Actions** for automated training and deployment workflows
-   Production **model monitoring** and **drift detection** for both classical ML and LLM endpoints
